_purpose: Working-sample filings that state whether booked claims provisions carry a management margin above the actuarial best estimate (the review of 2 October 2026, M-3; decision D3-2 of 4 October 2026). Each entry is a hit of the review's pattern scan (plan/review-2026-10-02/scratch/R1/margin_scan.py in the manuscript repository, pattern below), classified by reading its quote: held (a margin is carried), conditional ('a margin may be applied'), contradicting ('no margin ...'), or unclear. src/check_margin_sensitivity.py reads it. The review's scan read the text layer of the PDFs only, so it missed the 2024 filings published as HTML and every PDF whose pages are images. The PC rescan of 5 October 2026 read the 2024 HTML (a page carried as an image through E's PDF conversion), every 2014 filing, the two records that entered the working sample in stage 3, and the image-only PDFs through E's OCR page cache, each hit read from its page; it re-read every quote marked for the PC. The list is still a lower bound: the pattern finds only the wordings it names, and only working-sample filings are read. Every quote is a whole sentence copied from the filing; the why field gives its page.
_pattern: (margin[^.]{0,120}best estimate|best estimate[^.]{0,120}margin|management margin|margin (?:over|above|in excess of) (?:the )?(?:actuarial )?(?:best estimate|actuarial))
_source: plan/review-2026-10-02/scratch/R1/margin_scan.py and margin_scan.json (manuscript repository), 132 hits in 674 filings scanned, 0 errors; plus the PC rescan of 5 October 2026: the committed pattern (given in _pattern) run on the PC over the text layers of the working-sample filings, over E's OCR page cache for the image-only PDFs, and over the visible text of the 2024 HTML filings (including every 2014 filing and the two records that entered the working sample in stage 3), each new hit read from its page and each marked or flagged quote re-read from the filing: 193 entries in all
_classified: stage 3 of the fix cycle, 4 October 2026: every quote read; the PC checks the marked ones; the PC rescan of 5 October 2026 read every new hit and re-read every marked or flagged quote from the filing, the image-only pages by eye
